title: Return Potion Zoro
description: Forge mod for return potions to the spawn point for Minecraft.
body:
Forge mod for return (recall) potions to the spawn point for Minecraft.

The mod adds two types of potions:

- The yo-yo potion teleports the player to the spawn point for 30 seconds (1:30 for the redstone-enhanced version), after which it teleports the player to the point where the player drank the potion;
- The return potion has two uses. The first use teleports the player to the spawn point, while the second use teleports the player to the point where the potion was consumed.

Crafting is done on the crafting table.

- To make a yo-yo potion, you need to use a cloudy potion as the base and an ender pearl as the ingredient. You can also upgrade the potion by using red dust as the ingredient and a yo-yo potion as the base.
- To make a return potion, you need to use a yo-yo potion as the base and a chorus fruit as the ingredient.
